ph_address_search.desc: Search Philippine addresses, place names, and landmarks using OpenStreetMap Nominatim. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Philippine address or place name, for example 'Intramuros' or 'Ayala Avenue Makati'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_air_quality.desc: Get hourly air quality (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, SO2, CO, European AQI) for a starter city code. No API key required.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_air_temperature.desc: Get hourly air temperature readings for a starter city code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_airports.desc: List starter Philippine airports with IATA/ICAO codes and coordinates. Local catalog, not a live CAAP registry.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_banks.desc: Search a starter directory of major Philippine banks and SWIFT codes. Not an official BSP API.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional name/code filter, for example 'BDO' or 'Land Bank'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_barangays.desc: List barangays for a city or municipality PSGC (for example City of Manila = 133900000). No API key required.

params.name: city_code
params.desc: 9-digit city/municipality PSGC, for example '133900000' for City of Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_bsp_finance.desc: Get a USD/PHP (or other) exchange rate. Community feed, not an official Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas series. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_bus_stops.desc: Search nearby bus stops and stations via OpenStreetMap. Live OSM data — not live GTFS jeepney/EDSA Carousel feeds.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_cities.desc: List cities and municipalities for a province or region PSGC. Use region_code for NCR (no provinces). No API key required.

params.name: province_code
params.desc: 9-digit province PSGC, for example '072200000' for Cebu.

params.name: region_code
params.desc: 9-digit region PSGC used when province_code is omitted. Default NCR = 130000000.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_crypto_php.desc: Get CoinGecko spot prices quoted in Philippine pesos. No API key required for this simple endpoint.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_dataset_metadata.desc: Alias of ph_dataset_show for Singapore-style naming. Get HDX package metadata by id/name.

params.name: id
params.desc: CKAN package id or name, for example 'cod-ab-phl'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_dataset_query.desc: Query tabular HDX datastore records by resource_id (CKAN datastore_search). No API key required.

params.name: resource_id
params.desc: CKAN resource id that has datastore enabled.

params.name: q
params.desc: Optional full-text query across datastore fields.

params.name: filters
params.desc: Optional JSON filters string, for example '{"col":"value"}'.

params.name: sort
params.desc: Optional sort expression, for example 'col asc'.

params.name: fields
params.desc: Optional comma-separated field list to return.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_dataset_show.desc: Get full HDX dataset metadata and resources by package id or name. No API key required.

params.name: id
params.desc: CKAN package id or name, for example 'cod-ab-phl'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_datasets_search.desc: Search HDX Philippines open datasets via CKAN package_search. No API key required.

params.name: fq
params.desc: Optional CKAN filter query. Defaults to 'groups:phl'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_disease_reports.desc: Search HDX Philippines datasets for infectious-disease related open data (dengue, malaria, etc.). No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_earthquake_list.desc: List recent USGS earthquakes inside the Philippine bounding box. Not an official PHIVOLCS bulletin. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_elevation.desc: Get elevation (meters) for a latitude/longitude using Open-Meteo. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_evacuation_shelters.desc: List nearby evacuation / emergency assembly points from OpenStreetMap. Provide lat/lon. No API key required.

params.name: type
params.desc: 'evacuation' = shelters / assembly points, 'emergency' = emergency assembly points only.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_ferry_terminals.desc: Search nearby ferry terminals via OpenStreetMap. Live OSM data — not an official PPA/schedule API.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_fire_stations.desc: Search nearby fire stations via OpenStreetMap Overpass. Live OSM data — not a BFP official directory.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_flood.desc: Get GloFAS river-discharge forecast for a Philippine coordinate via Open-Meteo Flood. Not an official PAGASA flood bulletin.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_fuel_stations.desc: Search nearby fuel stations via OpenStreetMap. OSM POIs — not Department of Energy pump prices.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_geocode.desc: Convert a Philippine address or place name to latitude/longitude using Nominatim.

params.name: query
params.desc: Philippine address or place name to geocode.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_gold_price.desc: Get the spot gold (XAU) price in USD. Convert to PHP with ph_bsp_finance. Not a Bangko Sentral series.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_historical_weather.desc: Get daily historical weather (Open-Meteo archive) for a Philippine coordinate. Live no-key JSON.

params.name: start_date
params.desc: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

params.name: end_date
params.desc: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_hospitals.desc: Search nearby hospitals and clinics via OpenStreetMap. OSM community data — not an official DOH directory.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_id_format.desc: Check TIN / SSS / PhilHealth number shape only. Does not verify BIR, SSS, or PhilHealth membership.

params.name: value
params.desc: ID number, with or without dashes.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_long_weekend.desc: List long-weekend windows for a calendar year via Nager.Date. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_lto_plate.desc: Decode a 2014-series plate format to a likely issuing region. Local parser only — not an LTO registration lookup.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_marine.desc: Get wave height, direction, and period for Philippine coastal coordinates via Open-Meteo Marine. No API key required.

params.name: latitude
params.desc: Latitude, for example 14.5995 for Manila Bay.

params.name: longitude
params.desc: Longitude, for example 120.9842 for Manila Bay.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_metar.desc: Get the latest METAR observation for a Philippine airport (IATA or ICAO, default NAIA RPLL). No API key required.

params.name: airport
params.desc: IATA or ICAO code, for example 'MNL', 'RPLL', 'CEB', or 'RPVM'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_metro_stations.desc: List starter LRT-1, LRT-2, MRT-3, and PNR station coordinates. Not live GTFS or official timetables.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_mobile_network.desc: Identify the original Globe/Smart/DITO prefix of a mobile number. Local table only — number portability is not applied.

params.name: phone
params.desc: Mobile number or prefix, for example '09171234567' or '+63917...'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_natural_events.desc: NASA EONET open natural events (storms, volcanoes, wildfires) inside the Philippine bounding box. Not official PAGASA/PHIVOLCS.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_news.desc: Get latest headlines from Rappler, Philstar, or Inquirer RSS (via rss2json). No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_next_holidays.desc: List upcoming Philippine public holidays from today via Nager.Date. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_occurrences.desc: Live GBIF occurrence records geofiltered to country=PH. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional text filter, for example 'eagle' or 'coral'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_parse_psgc.desc: Slice a 9-digit PSGC code into region/province/city/barangay codes. Format only — use ph_regions for names.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_pharmacies.desc: Search nearby pharmacies via OpenStreetMap. OSM community data — not an official FDA/DOH directory.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_place_search.desc: Live Open-Meteo geocoding for Philippine place names (countryCode=PH). Complements Nominatim ph_geocode.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_police_stations.desc: Search nearby police stations via OpenStreetMap. OSM POIs — not PNP crime statistics.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_postal_code.desc: Convert a 4-digit Philippine ZIP code to place name and coordinates via Zippopotam.us. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_prayer_schedule.desc: Get Muslim prayer times for a Philippine city via Aladhan (default Manila). Not an official NCMF bulletin.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_provinces.desc: List Philippine provinces. Omit region_code for all provinces, or pass a region PSGC (NCR has no provinces). No API key required.

params.name: region_code
params.desc: Optional 9-digit region PSGC, for example '040000000' for CALABARZON. Omit to list all provinces.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_psa_catalog.desc: Browse PSA OpenSTAT PX-Web folders/tables (no key). This lists the catalog; it is not a live crime or fuel API.

params.name: path
params.desc: PX-Web path, for example 'DB' or a child id returned by a previous call.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_psa_query.desc: Live PSA OpenSTAT PX-Web datastore query (json-stat2). Uses the first value of each variable to keep the cube small.

params.name: path
params.desc: PX table path ending in .px from ph_psa_catalog.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_psa_table.desc: Live PSA OpenSTAT PX-Web table metadata (variables/values). Pass a .px path from ph_psa_catalog.

params.name: path
params.desc: PX table path ending in .px, for example 'DB/2E/AFC/0012E6CPHB0.px'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_pse_quote.desc: Get a Philippine Stock Exchange quote via the unofficial PHISIX community feed. Not an official PSE API.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_public_holidays.desc: List Philippine public holidays for a calendar year via Nager.Date. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_rainfall.desc: Get hourly rainfall readings for a starter city code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_regions.desc: List all Philippine regions with PSGC codes (for example NCR = 130000000). No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_relative_humidity.desc: Get hourly relative humidity readings for a starter city code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_reverse_geocode.desc: Convert latitude/longitude to a Philippine address using Nominatim. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_schools.desc: Search nearby schools, colleges, and universities via OpenStreetMap. OSM community data — not an official DepEd/CHED directory.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_species.desc: Search species names via GBIF (live, no key). Not limited to endemic-only records.

params.name: query
params.desc: Species or common-name query, for example 'tarsier' or 'maya'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_sunrise.desc: Get sunrise, sunset, and civil twilight for a Philippine coordinate. Timestamps are UTC (Asia/Manila is UTC+8).

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_tourism_spots.desc: Search nearby tourism spots (attractions, museums, viewpoints, etc.) via OpenStreetMap Overpass. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_tsunami_list.desc: List recent USGS events in the Philippine box with tsunami=1. Not an official PHIVOLCS tsunami bulletin.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_universities.desc: Search a starter Higher Education Institution catalog (UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, etc.). Not an official CHED registry.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional name/city filter, for example 'Cebu' or 'Ateneo'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_uv_index.desc: Get hourly UV index readings for a starter city code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_volcanoes.desc: List well-known Philippine volcanoes with coordinates. Local catalog — not a live PHIVOLCS alert level feed.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional name/province filter, for example 'Mayon' or 'Negros'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_24h.desc: Get 24-hour forecast (temperature, humidity, wind, rain, weather code) for a starter city code.

params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_4day.desc: Get 4-day forecast (conditions, temperature range, precipitation sum) for a starter city code.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila' for Manila.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_areas.desc: List starter forecast cities (for example Manila = manila). PAGASA TenDay JSON needs a token, so these codes feed Open-Meteo. No API key required.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_overview.desc: Get a daily weather overview for a starter city code (Open-Meteo, Asia/Manila). Not an official PAGASA bulletin.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: Starter city code, for example 'manila', 'cebu', or 'davao'.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_warnings.desc: Extract heavy-rain / thunderstorm slots from the Open-Meteo forecast. Not an official PAGASA warning.

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_weather_week_overview.desc: Get a 7-day weather overview for a starter city code (Open-Meteo, Asia/Manila).

response.note: Hit Run for live data from ph-mcp.

ph_worldbank.desc: World Bank open data for PHL (population, GDP, CPI, etc.). Default is population. Common ids: SP.POP.TOTL, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS, SP.DYN.LE00.IN.

params.name: indicator
params.desc: World Bank indicator id, for example 'SP.POP.TOTL' or 'NY.GDP.MKTP.CD'.
